notes.title: Minor update: fullscreen switching, bug fixes, gameplay changes, announcement
notes.content:
We have released a minor update that fixes a couple of outstanding issues. 

We will also be adjusting our release strategy for future content. Keep an eye out for an announcement coming soon with more details. "Long Road" is still coming. 

Patch Notes:
1: Added an option to switch between windowed and full screen. You can now also adjust the window size as needed.
2: Fixed an issue with reversed stereo
3: Tutorial level has been removed. 
4: Relics are now available as boss drops, allowing for some very powerful combinations if you're lucky. 
5: Various UI elements have had minor tweaks.
6: Moderate performance increase

Please feel free to give any feedback about issues you encounter after this update.

Also please remember that this is NOT the big update. We hope to have news regarding the marketing and release strategy of the big update very soon.

notes.title: Minor Update: Tech rebalance, class unlocks, fullscreen fix
notes.content:
Minor Update Notes:

[list]
[*] Removed all downsides for tech abilities and rebalanced all tech costs
[*] Added unlockables for class abilities only. Cosmetic effect of base classes are still DLC only. This will allow players to equip the ability of any other class, regardless of their selected class, but they must unlock this first by beating hell mode.
[*] Fixed fullscreen switching issue
[*] Reduced clearing radius of bosses and special enemies
[/list]

notes.title: Minor update: Motion sickness option
notes.content: Added option button to adjust mech movement for people sensitive to motion sickness.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43723828/acb65327b758737f08ed326fda31e183a62642c5.png[/img]	Hey all, here is a rough outline of whats planned for some of the next major updates to Machine Armor Zero
[list]
[*] Controller Support
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Tweaks to unlockables and weapon synergies
[*] Tooltip explanations
[*] Additional enemy types, bosses, boss abilities and end game challenges
[*] Additional weapons
[*] "Long Road" Additional game mode
[*] Additional customization layer (Pilots, special weapons)
[*] Incremental tweaks (sound effects, environment art, etc)

[/list]

Thanks everyone for your continued support during early access! Dont forget to leave feedback and reviews.

notes.title: Early Acccess patch 1: Damage numbers, upgrade points
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
	[b]Upgrades:[/b]
Resetting upgrades no longer has a cost. The amount returned will always be 100% of total
	
	[b]General:[/b]
Added option for damage numbers
	Added option to turn off HP HUD and show number only
	Enemy turrets now have a red glow to differentiate them from ally turrets
	Death animation and gameover screen are skippable
	
[b]Mega upgrades:[/b]
	Flat Damage: Tripled the potency
	Double shot: Changed to salvo shot chance
	Shield Stamina: Tripled potency
	
	[b]Minor Upgrades:[/b]
	Duration: Doubled the potency
	Cooldown: Doubled the potency
	Damage %: Doubled the potency
	Fire damage: Changed to flat damage
	
	[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
	Eye beam graphic now adjusts based on height
Chargeup graphic now adjusts based on height

notes.title: Prerelease Patch: Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
Pre-Release patch notes:
1: Lightning Gun
	[list]
[*] Now grants base chain lightning chance per level instead of maximum level
[*] 	Now summons a lightning dragon drone at maximum level
[/list]
2: Flamethrower
	[list]
[*] No longer has a stacking attack speed buff. Now deals damage over time at base level
[*] 	No longer deals DOT damage at max level, now grants all weapons a chance to spread ground fire
[/list]
3: Blaster
	[list]
[*] Now always fires ultra shots at maximum level
[*] 	No longer grants chance to fire ultra shots at maximum level, now grants a chance to gain blaster charge at maximum level
[/list]
4: Beam
	[list]
[*] Beam has been renamed to Cryo beam. No longer grants double shot chance per level. Now grants a chance for any weapon to freeze enemies
[*] 	No longer always pierces by default
[*] 	At maximum level, it evolves into Nuclear Beam, granting all weapons a chance to restore nuke ammo
[/list]
5: Meteor Gun
[list]
[*] 	No longer grants Auto Meteor per level. Now grants auto meteor at maximum level
[*] 	No longer grants meteor storage at maximum level. Now grants meteor storage charges on kill per level
[/list]
6: Missile Launcher
	[list]
[*] No longer grants explosion chance on hit to all weapons per level. Now grants double shot chance per level
[*] 	Now grants explosion chance on hit to all weapons at maximum level
[/list]
7: Blade Gun
	[list]
[*] No longer grants dodge per level. Now grants seeking chance per level to all weapons
[*] 	No longer grants a chance to spawn blades on dodge at maximum level. Now always spawns blades periodically while at maximum level
[/list]
8: Psionic Blade
	[list]
[*] No longer grants auto-psy attack at maximum level. Now periodically fires a psi beam at nearby enemies, instantly killing them if possible. 
[/list]
9: Misc 
	[list]
[*] Spike attacks now have less aggressive culling measures and can occur more often
[*] 	Hit effects have been streamlined to no longer need graphical culling measures
[*] 	Reduced the size of humans
[*] 	Added incremental loading for certain objects 
[/list]
9: Enviornment
[list]
[*] 	Updated some environment art
[*] 	Updated all tutorial areas
[/list]
	
10: Bugs fixes
	[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could sometimes target the ground if you were locked on to an enemy and it died while there were no other valid targets in range. 
[*] 	Fixed a bug where double shot would cause missiles to split 5 times instead of 2
[*] Fixed a bug where one of the tutorial rooms was randomized
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch: Update 1
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
[olist]
[*] Increased the base duration of tooltips
[*] Added "Skip tutorial" button to main menu
[*] Added tutorial hint for zooming in and out

[*] Added overlay to starting screen indicating early access/demo builds
